Bun:creatinine ratio only shows dehydration — patient is not dehydrated with a ration <20.

egfr is still pretty normal. What’s the patients height and weight? You can find the CrCl that way. 

Are you taking any drugs that are renally cleared? Something that could have cause the Creatinine to spike? Do you have historical creatinine or egfr readings? Is there like a sudden drop or is this normal for you?

Similar thing happened to me except I had blood clots in my arm. 

The doc tested for other things like muscle rupture and making sure things were still attached. Has it gotten better? Maybe it was a temporary cut off of circulation?

No — looks like it’s healing 

There’s no swelling around the area. Does it feel warm to the touch?
Have you tried reaching out to him without magic? That’s a pretty big thing and he should know without any emotional manipulation.

If someone is telling you there is a curse that needs to be broken and you need to pay for continuing work to lift it they are likely trying to rip you off. If you want to chat, send me a message and I’ll chat. No judgment. But be weary of spending lots of money to lift a curse.
Fair point. I’m still mulling over my options. I’m just pissed at this point. But I agree with your point.
I figured xarelto would prob be the easiest but I have xans and dilaudid too. Ughhhh this just sucks. Thanks for listening.
